verdict.rationale: Visa provides documented REST APIs (POST /acp/v1/tokens, /acp/v1/instructions, /acp/v1/instructions/{id}/credentials) with clear request/response fields, sandbox self-service signup, and runtime probes confirming the live gateway and MCP server (npm package, versioned) actually resolve. This is a well-documented public API surface for an AI-native agent to drive enrollment, mandates, credential retrieval, and payment confirmation programmatically. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer accounts of building against the API (beyond Visa's own docs/probes) and clearer production-readiness given the 'in development' maturity caveat.
